transport: Independent child process and real 127.0.0.1 TCP sockets; incomplete and malformed frames close or fail before effect dispatch
crash: SIGKILL the first worker in broker beforePersist(committed), after durable sink write; explicitly recover dead journal owner and reconcile in a new worker
replay: Run every terminal event through isolated broker replay with live policy and adapter callbacks forbidden
qualification: Complete process/socket campaign throughput is reported and compared with the unchanged R04 target; this bounded campaign has no host-level partition, arbitrary effectful candidate admission, or distributed production deployment
